about: Novy Urengoy Airport is managed by Aeroporty Regionov management company. Scheduled flights serve 19 destinations; in 2025 the airport handled more than 1 million passengers.

transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: Bus No. 101 Yamal-Express from the railway station, 18 min. Bus No. 3 from the railway station, 30 min, every 8–15 min, 43 ₽. Bus No. 1 from the Sever district, 45 min, every 8–10 min, 43 ₽.

parking.title: Parking
parking.text: Drop-off and pick-up zone: 15 min free, up to 60 min 540 ₽, then 540 ₽/hour. Car park P1 with no free time: up to 60 min 320 ₽, up to 2 hours 560 ₽, up to 24 hours 740 ₽. Free car park P0 with 55 spaces at the Vertodrom stop, 2 stops from the terminal.

lounges.title: Lounges
lounges.text: Business lounge in the waiting area after security. Admits business class passengers, members of Persona.Aero, ON PASS, Grey Wall, Every Lounge, GoldenKey and self-paying passengers. Price 5,800 ₽ for up to 3 hours, then 550 ₽ for each hour.

storage.title: Left luggage
storage.text: Automated left luggage in the departure hall on Level 1. Standard locker 500 ₽ per day or 200 ₽ per hour, large 900 ₽ per day or 300 ₽ per hour. The locker opens with the barcode on the receipt.

wifi.title: Wi‑Fi
wifi.text: Free Wi‑Fi in passenger areas. Select the FREE_NUX network and confirm login with a mobile phone number.
